species.title: Wild bees
species.needs: Forest covering at least a sixth of the island, and a farm.
species.effect: Pollinate crops: farms grow 15% faster while bees are around.

species.title: Seabirds
species.effect: Villagers gather eggs: a little extra food every day.

species.title: Tree frogs
species.needs: Standing fresh water - ponds, wet lowland or a dam reservoir.
species.effect: Eat insects: locust swarms cannot take hold while frogs are present.

species.title: Island wolves
species.needs: A large wild goat herd (22+) and a quarter of the island forested.
species.effect: Hunt goats, keeping the herd from overgrazing the pasture.
